# Shadowkin
Shadowkin are a small humanoid species who speak [color=#be3cc5]Marish[/color], a language comprised overwhelmingly of consonants.
They are generally smaller than other species, though occasionally some shadowkin will be larger than the average human. In any case, all shadowkin are incredibly lightweight, though they're still heavier than Harpies.
They are innately telepathic, and can interact with each other through something called [color=#7f32a8]"Empathy"[/color] (accessed by typing +s before your chat message). The shadowkin's top two ears generally transmit messages in empathy, while the bottom two recieve it.
They have highly sensitive eyes. Specialty sunglasses which would normally protect a human from being flashed do not work on shadowkin. However, shadowkin have remarkable night vision capabilities. Interestingly, shadowkin appear not to have visible pupils.
